note: Rewritten from the original English description of NASUTITERMES (NASUTITERMES) PILOSUS, new species in Snyder's paper on the termites of the Amazon basin, which covers the soldier and the worker; the alate is not described in the original. The original was extracted from a two-column PDF with a line break at every word and has been reordered semantically; in the worker the head width 1.25—1.85 mm is greater than the head length and is suspected to be an OCR error for 1.25—1.35 mm; it has not been changed and is transcribed as it stands.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head jet black, smooth, shiny; nasus paler (reddish brown), pyriform, nearly straight in lateral view, raised at the base of the nasus and concave behind the swelling; two rows of long hairs, one at the base of the nasus and one on the vertex. Nasus conical, neither elongated nor very thick. Mandible apices sharp. Antennae brown, 13—14-segmented, the segments gradually longer and wider towards the apex, covered with long hairs; with 13 segments the third is elongated, slender, nearly club-shaped, longer than the second or the fourth, the fourth shorter than the second, the fifth longer than the fourth or the second; with 14 segments the third is narrow, nearly club-shaped, shorter than the second or the fourth, the fourth and the second nearly equal, the fifth slightly shorter or nearly equal, but the sixth longer than the fourth; apical segment slender, short, nearly elliptical. Pronotum chestnut brown, saddle-shaped; anterior margin darker, not concave, with long hairs. Legs brown, slender, with long hairs. Abdominal tergites dark chestnut brown, the base of each tergite with a row of long hairs and densely covered with shorter hairs; cerci rather long, conspicuous. Measurements: soldier total length 3.80—4.00 mm; head including nasus 1.55—1.65 mm; head length (excluding nasus, to the anterior margin) 1.00—1.05 mm; nasus length 0.60 mm; pronotal length 0.20—0.25 mm; hind tibia length 1.35 mm; head width 0.95—1.05 mm; pronotal width 0.60 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head dark, jet black, with a transparent median longitudinal line connecting the fontanelle with the coronal suture, covered with long hairs and dense short hairs; antennae 14—15-segmented; abdominal tergites with long hairs and dense short hairs. Measurements: worker total length 4.70—5.02 mm (mean 4.70 mm); head length 1.40—1.65 mm; head width 1.25—1.85 mm.
